svg.text: Would a cap of 3 rounds help? It would mostly silence findings on new code.
82 PRs (6.3% of 1,301) went past round 3. They produced 418 findings after it.

g.text: 66.2% on code the fixes had just changed
140 of the 414 findings with a known anchor were churn on old code.
274 were about lines the fixes had just touched: new code, which is what a cap would drop.
So tollgate does not drop them.
At the cap it escalates: a human decides, instead of round 4, 5 and 6.

svg.text: 4 findings had no usable anchor and are left out of the percentages. Five public repos; this measures anchoring, not validity.
